tasks.goal:
Build ~/.hermes/scripts/lyapunov-analysis.py from scratch.

This script implements KHALIL-3 (Khalil 'Nonlinear Systems' 3rd ed, Chapter 4) phase portrait and Lyapunov stability analysis for Hermes agent loops.

Subcommands:
1. phase-portrait: given --system (one of: 'pid', 'retry', 'memory') plot a 2D phase portrait by numerically integrating a 2D ODE system using scipy.integrate.odeint. For 'pid': dx/dt = y, dy/dt = -x - 0.5*y (damped oscillator). For 'retry': dx/dt = -x*(x-1)*(x-2), dy/dt = -y

Add OT-12 (Bregman barycenter --ot-stack) to ~/.hermes/scripts/skill-stacking.py AND add OT-13 (W1-discriminative routing) to ~/.hermes/scripts/memory-query-router.py.

STEP 1 — Read both files first before touching anything:
  cat ~/.hermes/scripts/skill-stacking.py
  cat ~/.hermes/scripts/memory-query-router.py
